description:
-Solve 100 unique levels in an ice world
-Match 3 identical princess crystals to break them and generate combos
-Collect coins, unlock incredible bonuses and use them like chocolate bombs, candy explosions and more!
-Beautiful art for princesses
-No in-app-purchases or ads!
name: Ice Princess Crystals
intro: Solve 100 levels in this match 3 game with a beautiful princess in a magical ice world
